## Description {#details}

<p>Represents a value which can be a <a href="/web-llvm/docs/api/classes/llvm/register">Register</a> or a constant.</p>


<p>This is useful in situations where an instruction may have an interesting register operand or interesting constant operand. For a concrete example,</p>
